applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Small finance banks must apply modified asset classification, maintain additional specific provisions for restructured accounts, and follow revised interest income recognition rules.
answer.action_quote: A bank shall make an additional specific provision of five percent of the outstanding debt in respect of borrowers

effective_date.quote: The above amendment shall come into force with effect from July 1, 2026.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning) Directions
